_comment: The places, checked in November 2026 against their own pages and the press. 地点，2026年11月对照各家官网和媒体报道核实。

items.name: Daunt Books Marylebone
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: The original Daunt shop on Marylebone High Street, known for arranging its travel books by country alongside fiction and non-fiction for each place. It runs author talks and signings.
items.whyZh: 丹特书店在玛丽勒本大街的总店，旅行类书籍按国家分区，同一地区的小说和非虚构放在一起。书店还举办作家讲座和签售。

items.name: Foyles
items.subtitle: Large general bookshop
items.why: A very large general bookshop on Charing Cross Road, laid out over several floors with strong art, music and cinema sections, a café and an events floor.
items.whyZh: 查令十字街上的大型综合书店，分多个楼层，艺术、音乐和电影类书籍很丰富，还设有咖啡馆和活动层。

items.name: Hatchards
items.subtitle: Historic Piccadilly bookshop
items.why: A bookshop on Piccadilly that has traded since 1797, billed as London's oldest surviving bookshop. Several floors of general stock, with a good reputation for signed editions and travel and biography titles.
items.whyZh: 皮卡迪利大街上的书店，1797年开业，被称为伦敦现存最古老的书店。楼层多、书目综合，签名版以及旅行和传记类书籍口碑不错。

items.name: John Sandoe (Books) Ltd
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: An independent bookshop in a Georgian terrace off the King's Road, trading since 1957. Its tall shelves hold a general range, and the staff are known for recommending books.
items.whyZh: 国王路旁乔治亚式排屋里的独立书店，1957年开业。书架高耸，书目综合，店员以乐于推荐好书闻名。

items.name: Libreria Bookshop
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A bookshop near Brick Lane whose shelves are grouped by theme and curiosity rather than the usual categories. Good for finding something you were not looking for.
items.whyZh: 位于砖巷附近的书店，书架按主题和兴趣而不是常规分类来排列，适合碰运气发现原本没打算找的书。

items.name: London Review Bookshop
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A bookshop beside the British Museum, run by the London Review of Books, with a thoughtful general range and regular events. A café next door is now an outpost of St. JOHN.
items.whyZh: 紧邻大英博物馆的书店，由《伦敦书评》经营，书目选得很用心，也常办活动。隔壁的咖啡馆现在是St. JOHN的分店。

items.name: The Notting Hill Bookshop
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A small independent shop on Blenheim Crescent that inspired the bookshop in the film Notting Hill. It stocks a broad general range with a good travel section, and sits a few steps from the Portobello Road crowds.
items.whyZh: 布伦海姆新月街上的小型独立书店，是电影《诺丁山》中书店的原型。书的种类广，旅行类尤其丰富，离波多贝罗路的人流只有几步之遥。
items.hoursZh: 周一至周日 9:00–19:00（公共假日同样营业）

items.name: Artwords Bookshop
items.subtitle: Art and design bookshop
items.why: An independent Broadway Market shop for books on contemporary visual culture, mostly fine art, with photography, graphic design, architecture, fashion and magazines too. Handy for browsing before or after the market.
items.whyZh: 百老汇市集上的独立书店，专营当代视觉文化图书，以当代美术为主，也有摄影、平面设计、建筑、时尚类图书和杂志。逛市集前后都适合顺道翻翻。
items.note: Its website was being rebuilt in November 2026, so check it is open before a special trip.
items.noteZh: 其官网在2026年11月正在改版，专程前往前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Donlon Books
items.subtitle: Art and photography books
items.why: A small Broadway Market shop for art, photography and cultural theory, with artist books, zines, rare titles and posters. A good place to find independent publications you won't see in big chains.
items.whyZh: 百老汇市集上的小书店，专营艺术、摄影和文化理论书籍，还有艺术家书、独立杂志、珍本和海报。适合来找大连锁书店里见不到的独立出版物。

items.name: Gay's The Word
items.subtitle: LGBTQ+ bookshop
items.why: The UK's oldest LGBTQ+ bookshop, on Marchmont Street in Bloomsbury since 1979. Fiction, non-fiction and community notices, and a good first stop for queer writing.
items.whyZh: 英国历史最悠久的LGBTQ+书店，1979年起在布鲁姆斯伯里的马奇蒙特街营业，有小说、非虚构类书籍，也有社区信息，想了解酷儿文学可以先来这里。

items.name: Kirkdale Bookshop
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A friendly Sydenham shop selling new and second-hand books, with a good children's and young adult section. A local favourite a short walk from Sydenham station.
items.whyZh: 锡德纳姆一家亲切的书店，新书和二手书都有，童书和青少年读物尤其丰富。离锡德纳姆车站不远，是当地人常去的地方。

items.name: Lutyens & Rubinstein
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A two-floor Notting Hill bookshop opened by two literary agents, with a carefully chosen mix of fiction, non-fiction, children's books and gifts. A calm stop away from the Portobello crowds.
items.whyZh: 由两位文学经纪人在诺丁山开设的两层书店，精选小说、非虚构、童书和礼品。远离波多贝罗路的喧闹，适合安静地逛逛。

items.name: Newham Bookshop
items.subtitle: Community bookshop
items.why: A not-for-profit independent shop on Barking Road in Plaistow, selling new books only, with events, a monthly book pick and a strong local following. A trip for people who like community bookshops.
items.whyZh: 位于普莱斯托巴金路上的非营利独立书店，只卖新书，常办活动，每月推荐一本书，在当地很受欢迎。喜欢社区书店的人值得专程前往。

items.name: Nomad Books
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A local independent bookshop on Fulham Road, open since 1990, with a general stock and a regular programme of author talks, signings and children's storytimes.
items.whyZh: 富勒姆路上的社区独立书店，1990年起营业，书目种类齐全，经常举办作家讲座、签售和儿童故事会。

items.name: Owl Bookshop
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A long-standing Kentish Town Road bookshop with a general range, plus gifts, bags and a regular events programme.
items.whyZh: 肯蒂什镇路上开了多年的书店，书目综合，也卖礼品和布袋，还定期举办活动。

items.name: Persephone Books
items.subtitle: Publisher and bookshop
items.why: A publisher that reprints neglected fiction and non-fiction, mostly by women and mostly from the mid-20th century, all in grey jackets with patterned endpapers. The London shop has reopened in Fitzrovia.
items.whyZh: 专门重印被遗忘的小说和非虚构作品的出版社，作者多为女性、年代多在20世纪中叶，所有书都是灰色封面配图案环衬。伦敦书店已在菲茨罗维亚重新开张。

items.name: Presse Books
items.subtitle: Arts bookshop and café
items.why: The arts bookshop and project space at Forma's Southwark base, stocking Forma's own publications, artist editions and books on art, architecture and poetry. It has a café, and hosts book launches and performances.
items.whyZh: Forma 位于萨瑟克的艺术书店兼项目空间，售卖 Forma 自己的出版物、艺术家版本图书，以及艺术、建筑和诗歌类书籍。店里有咖啡馆，也常办新书发布和表演活动。
items.address: FormaHQ, Peveril Garden Studios, 140 Great Dover St, London SE1 4GW
items.note: Open Tuesday to Friday only; see the news page for events.
items.noteZh: 仅周二至周五营业；活动安排见其新闻页面。

items.name: Primrose Hill Books
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A family-run bookshop in a Victorian terrace two minutes from Primrose Hill, selling new and second-hand books, signed copies and gifts.
items.whyZh: 樱草山旁维多利亚式排屋里的家族书店，离樱草山步行约两分钟，卖新书、二手书、签名本和礼品。

items.name: Review
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A small neighbourhood bookshop on Bellenden Road, Peckham, with literary fiction, magazines and zines, and a small garden. It also hosts book groups and the Peckham Literary Festival.
items.whyZh: 佩卡姆贝伦登路上的社区小书店，主打文学小说，也有杂志和独立刊物，还有一个小花园。书店办读书会，并参与佩卡姆文学节。

items.name: Sotheran's Rare Books & Prints
items.subtitle: Antiquarian bookshop
items.why: A long-established antiquarian dealer selling rare books, prints and manuscripts, on Charing Cross Road with a second shop in nearby Cecil Court. Worth a browse if you like old books and prints.
items.whyZh: 历史悠久的古籍书商，经营珍本书、版画和手稿，店面在查令十字街，附近的塞西尔庭院另有一家分店。喜欢旧书和版画的人值得进来逛逛。
items.hoursZh: 周一至周五 10:00–18:00（查令十字街店）
items.note: The Cecil Court shop (8 Cecil Court) also opens on Saturdays, 11:00–17:00.
items.noteZh: 塞西尔庭院8号的分店周六也营业，11:00–17:00。

items.name: Stanfords
items.subtitle: Travel books and maps
items.why: A specialist travel bookshop in Covent Garden for maps, globes and guidebooks, founded in 1853 and now at Mercer Walk. There is a café inside.
items.whyZh: 位于科文特花园的旅行专门书店，出售地图、地球仪和旅行指南，创办于1853年，现址在默瑟步道。店内设有咖啡馆。

items.name: Swedenborg House
items.subtitle: Society bookshop and gallery
items.why: The home of the Swedenborg Society in Bloomsbury, with a small bookshop and a gallery. A quiet stop for philosophy, spirituality and the society's own publications.
items.whyZh: 瑞典堡学会在布鲁姆斯伯里的总部，设有小书店和展厅。想找哲学、灵修类书籍和学会自己出版的书，可以来这里安静地逛一逛。

items.name: Tenderbooks
items.subtitle: Art and design bookshop
items.why: A small bookshop on Cecil Court for art, design, architecture, photography and fashion, with rare and out-of-print titles, artist books, magazines and prints.
items.whyZh: 塞西尔庭院里的小书店，专营艺术、设计、建筑、摄影和时尚类书籍，也有珍本、绝版书、艺术家书、杂志和版画。

items.name: The Broadway Bookshop
items.subtitle: Independent bookshop
items.why: A small independent bookshop at the canal end of Broadway Market, handy for a browse before or after the street's cafés and Saturday stalls.
items.whyZh: 位于百老汇市集运河一端的小型独立书店，在市集的咖啡馆和周六摊位之间逛书很顺路。
items.note: No delivery; online orders are collected in the shop.
items.noteZh: 不提供送货，网上订的书需到店自取。

items.name: Word On The Water - The London Bookbarge
items.subtitle: Floating bookshop
items.why: A bookshop on a barge moored on the Regent's Canal near King's Cross, selling books to browse on board. Worth a visit for the setting as much as the stock.
items.whyZh: 停靠在国王十字附近摄政运河上的驳船书店，可以上船翻书。书固然有看头，船上的环境同样值得一来。
items.note: On a boat, so hours and mooring can change with weather; check the shop's social pages before a special trip.
items.noteZh: 书店在船上，营业时间和停靠位置可能随天气变化，专程前往前请先看店家的社交媒体。

items.name: BookMongers
items.subtitle: Second-hand bookshop
items.why: A well-organised second-hand bookshop a few minutes from Brixton station, open since 1992 and covering plays, poetry, travel, politics, cinema and more. Easy to lose an hour in.
items.whyZh: 距布里克斯顿车站几分钟的二手书店，1992年开业，涵盖戏剧、诗歌、旅行、政治和电影等类别，书架整理得井井有条，很容易一逛就是一小时。

items.name: Foster Books
items.subtitle: Antiquarian and second-hand books
items.why: A family-run Chiswick High Road shop for rare, out-of-print and second-hand books, including first editions, fine bindings and illustrated children's titles. One for patient browsers.
items.whyZh: 奇斯威克大街上的家族经营书店，出售珍本、绝版书和二手书，包括初版书、精装本和插画童书。适合有耐心慢慢翻找的人。

items.name: Gosh! Comics
items.subtitle: Comic and graphic novel shop
items.why: A comics and graphic novel shop on Berwick Street in Soho, open every day. A handy stop if you are around the market or the record shops.
items.whyZh: 苏豪伯威克街上的漫画和图像小说店，每天营业。逛集市或唱片店时顺路进来很方便。

items.name: London Centre for Book Arts
items.subtitle: Book arts studio
items.why: An artist-run open-access studio near Hackney Wick for letterpress, printmaking, papermaking and bookbinding. Most visitors come for a course or a studio session rather than to browse.
items.whyZh: 位于哈克尼威克附近、由艺术家运营的开放式工作室，提供活版印刷、版画、造纸和装订等课程与场地。多数人是来上课或使用工作室，而不是随便逛逛。
items.address: Unit 18, Britannia Works, 56 Dace Rd, London E3 2NQ
items.note: Mainly courses, studio access and occasional open days; check the website before turning up.
items.noteZh: 主要是课程、工作室使用和不定期的开放日，前往前请先查看官网。

items.name: The Bookshop on the Heath
items.subtitle: Second-hand and antiquarian books
items.why: A second-hand bookshop in Blackheath village selling rare and older books, modern titles, maps, prints and posters. A pleasant browse after a walk on the heath.
items.whyZh: 布莱克希思村里的二手书店，出售珍本旧书、新近出版的书，还有地图、版画和海报。逛完荒野公园散步后，顺路进来翻翻很惬意。
